events.name: Mirror Panther
events.description: Night, a black marble bathroom lit in gold: you stand with your palm on the mirror and look back over your shoulder, while a black panther in the glass presses its paw to your hand, eyes glowing amber.

events.name: Giant Ramp Climbing
events.description: You sprint across a wet concrete floor and straight up the huge curved wall of a dam in front of a packed grandstand, flip off the railing at the top, slide back down in a burst of spray and come up to the camera shouting with your fists in the air.

events.name: Smooth Criminal Dance
events.description: Two dancers in navy tank tops and wide light trousers on a paved path in front of a row of green trees, filmed from a phone on the ground, do the 15-second Smooth Criminal routine in sync: a hand at the neck, a lean and a kick, both hands up over the head, side glides and wide-stance arm shapes.

events.name: Strike a Pole
events.description: Your two pets up on their hind legs on a garden brick path: one swings round an old black lamp post, then the other cuts in and they dance as a pair.
